text:
Not that the evidence shows. NASA FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F08 between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-03 (as known on 2026-11-12). All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered the whole period, so the lack of detections isn't a gap in coverage.

Some limits apply:
- This doesn't prove no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected.
- It says nothing about burned area, so a burn scar check would need separate evidence.
- It doesn't speak to the cause of any change on the property (harvest, storm, clearing, fire).
- It covers only that 30-day window. Earlier fires, or any after 2026-11-03, aren't addressed.

In short: no fire signal in the last month, but low-confidence for small or brief fires.
